relations.subject: Alfred Senn
relations.evidence: studied at Fribourg and Heidelberg. Ph.D. 1921 Fribourg

relations.subject: Alfred Senn
relations.evidence: In 1922-30 taught as Docent at Kaunas University.

relations.subject: Alfred Senn
relations.evidence: In 1930-31 Sterling Research Fellow in Germanistics at Yale.

relations.subject: Alfred Senn
relations.role: Professor of Germanic and IE Philology
relations.evidence: taught in 1931-38 as Professor of Germanic and IE Philology at University of Wisconsin in Madison.

relations.subject: Alfred Senn
relations.evidence: From 1938 Professor of Germanistics at University of Pennsylvania in Philadelphia (from 1948 also of Baltic and Slavic).

relations.subject: Alfred Senn
relations.object: Department of Slavic and Baltic Studies
relations.evidence: In 1947 he founded there the Department of Slavic and Baltic Studies and chaired it until his retirement.

relations.subject: Alfred Senn
relations.evidence: Married 1923 Marija Eva Vedlugaite, the historian Alfred Erich Senn (1932–2016) is their son.
